/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import collections, re
# parse cdna headers
gs={}
for line in open('cdna.fa'):
    if line.startswith('>'):
        parts=line.rstrip().split(' ')
        tid=parts[0][1:]
        d={}
        for p in parts[1:]:
            if ':' in p:
                k,v=p.split(':',1); d[k]=v
        gs[tid]=d.get('gene_symbol')
# parse SAM
reads={}
counts=collections.defaultdict(int)
different=[]
# Need line refs etc. primary alignments only; skip secondary/supplementary
for line in open('aln.sam'):
    if line.startswith('@'): continue
    f=line.split('\\t')
    qname=f[0]; flag=int(f[1]); rname=f[2]; pos=int(f[3]); cigar=f[5]
    if flag & 0x900: # secondary/supp
        continue
    if flag & 0x4: # unmapped
        mate = f[6] if len(f)>6 else '*'
        prev=reads.get(qname)
        if prev is not None:
            pass
        continue
    prev=reads.get(qname)
    if prev is not None:
        g1=gs.get(prev[0]); g2=gs.get(rname)
        pair=(g1,g2)
        counts[pair]+=1
        if g1 and g2 and g1"'!=g2:
            different.append((qname, prev, f))
        del reads[qname]
    else:
        reads[qname]=(rname,pos,cigar,flag,f)
print('"'total pairs', sum(counts.values()))
print('diff pair count', len(different))
diffc=collections.Counter((a[1][0], a[2][2]) for a in different) # actually a structure
# structure: qname, prev=(rname,pos,cigar,flag,f), f=list
diffc=collections.Counter((a[1][0], a[2][2]) for a in different)
diffg=collections.Counter((gs.get(a[1][0]), gs.get(a[2][2])) for a in different)
print('top transcript pairs:')
for p,c in diffc.most_common(50): print(c,p)
print('\\ntop gene pairs:')
for p,c in diffg.most_common(50): print(c,p)
print('\\ncounts top any pairs:')
for p,c in counts.most_common(20): print(c,p)
PY"
